cross_design_caveat: CM/CH has96KiB conventional data and768 line slots,PIB256/MSHR512/finite0. DM/DH has512 logical tag slots,640physical128B lines(80KiB),OO PIB128/MSHR conventional fallback32/finite1. Shared memory98304 configured; total SRAM ownership/area/timing equivalence is not established. No equal-area or pure-AE cross-design claim.
hash_family: For sets S=2^s, line=a>>7; bank=line&3; row=((line>>2)^(line>>s))&((S/4)-1); set=4*row+bank. CH S32 vs DH S64 use same family but configured index widths differ. One fixed mapping for all programs; no per-program choice.
